## QUESTION 1


__Reproduce the chart Elliot using the data from the names_year.csv file. If, after a couple of hours, you can get the chart close, but not exactly the same, that is okay. You will learn more to the degree you push yourself__

_Here is the graph._

```{python}
# Q1
elliot = (
    df.filter(
        (pl.col("name") == "Elliot") &
        (pl.col("year") >= 1950)
    )
    .select(["name", "year", "Total"])
)
(
    ggplot(elliot, aes(x="year", y="Total", color="name"))
    + geom_line(size=1)
    + scale_color_manual(values=["blue"])
    + theme_gray()
    + theme(
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        text=element_text(family="serif", size=15),
        axis_ticks=element_blank(),
        plot_title_position="plot",
        plot_title=element_text(
            margin=[0, 0, 5, 15],
            size=20
        ),
        axis_title_x=element_text(
            size=20,
            margin=[10, 0, 0, 0]
        ),
        legend_position="right",
        legend_justification="top",
        legend_margin=[3, 18]
    )
    + scale_x_continuous(format="d", expand=[0, 0], limits=[None, 2025])
    + scale_y_continuous(format="d", expand=[0.08, 0])
    + ggsize(800, 408)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=1982, linetype=2, color="red", size=1)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=1984, linetype=2, color="red", size=1)
    + geom_vline(xintercept=2002, linetype=2, color="red", size=1)
    + geom_text(
        x=1982,
        y=2500,
        size=8,
        nudge_x=-1,
        nudge_y=500,
        label="E.T. Released",
        hjust=1,
        inherit_aes=False
    )
    + geom_text(
        x=1984,
        y=2500,
        size=8,
        nudge_x=1,
        nudge_y=500,
        label="Second Release",
        hjust=0,
        inherit_aes=False
    )
    + geom_text(
        x=2002,
        y=2500,
        size=8,
        nudge_x=1,
        nudge_y=500,
        label="Third Release",
        hjust=0,
        inherit_aes=False
    )
    + labs(
        y="",
        title="Elliot...What?"
    )
)
```
